content:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — the docs link-linter and a few manual checks turned up some regressions after the v1->v2 swap. need a short audit and small PRs, not a big rewrite.
Docs Bot: automated-link-checker results: 3 broken/redirected endpoints detected -> /v1/models (404) should 301 -> /v2/models, /docs/embed-dim (404) -> /docs/embeddings#dimensions, /sdk/python/invoke (404) -> /sdk/python/examples. Also flagged code samples using `model=` param (v1) — v2 uses `model_id`.
Ryan Patel: re embeds — note that embedding dim differs across model families. we should add a short callout in the embeddings guide, not just redirect. customers will trip on dims when swapping models.
Jon Alvarez: confirmed — python snippets break because `client.invoke(...)` examples changed to `client.call(...)` in the new sdk. I have a branch that updates examples + tests, will open PR.
Kevin Li: I can run the smoke tests on the docs site and patch redirect rules in the static site `_redirects` file on Netlify. what redirect format do we want? 301 or 302?
Sophia Gupta: 301 permanent for docs pages, but add a deprecation banner on the old routes for 60 days before removing server-side redirects. Also add a migration checklist at the top of the v1->v2 guide.
Maya Chen: proposed task split: @Kevin Li -> add redirects + run smoke; @Jon Alvarez -> python snippet update PR; @Ryan Patel -> embeddings callout + small example; @Sophia Gupta -> banner + migration checklist; I'll file a master tracking PR for docs owners to review. sound ok? :+1:
Jon Alvarez: quick Q — do we need to regenerate any codegen outputs (openapi samples) because of the `model` -> `model_id` rename? that could affect snippet generation.
Ryan Patel: yes the codegen for embed examples uses a template variable `{{model}}`. I'll search/replace in templates to `{{model_id}}` and back-compat note in the template docs.
Docs Bot: deploy preview summary: PR #4321 (jon) => preview OK, PR #4330 (sophia) => preview failed (broken include: /includes/migration-checklist.md missing), link-checker attached.
Kevin Li: adding suggested redirect lines for Netlify:```
/v1/models  /v2/models  301
/docs/embed-dim  /docs/embeddings#dimensions  301
/sdk/python/invoke  /sdk/python/examples  301
```I'll push as a tiny PR and run smoke.
Sophia Gupta: on the banner text — I propose: "Deprecation notice: v1 API endpoints and SDK shims will be removed on YYYY-MM-DD. See migration guide for automated code samples and quick fixes." Put it above the TOC and in the v1 guide header.
Maya Chen: timeline: we want to announce deprecation in 7 days, then 60-day notice, then remove redirects after 90 days. Ops ok with that? If so I'll add dates to the banner.
Jon Alvarez: PR #4321 contains the python snippet changes + unit-test updates. pinging @maya for quick review.
Kevin Li: smoke test results: local preview passed link checks except the missing include. I'll re-run after Sophia's include is created.
Sophia Gupta: creating /includes/migration-checklist.md now, will reference it from both v1 and v2 docs. adding checklist items: model param rename, SDK method rename, embed dims, redirect table, and example repro steps.
Maya Chen: perfect. small nit — add a one-line snippet to the migration checklist showing the minimal code change:```
# v1
resp = client.invoke(model='redwood-1', prompt='...')
# v2
resp = client.call(model_id='redwood-2', input='...')
```This helps folks immediately.
Jon Alvarez: good idea. i'll include that exact snippet in the python PR.
Docs Bot: NOTE: automated-redirect-creator will not act until a human-approved PR is merged.
Kevin Li: after PRs are merged i'll run the public smoke tests and report back here with the preview link. expected by EOD.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone — let's keep updates concise here. if you hit anything that blocks merging, call it out and i'll escalate. :pray:
